powershell.exe -Command "Copy-Item .\\main.py .\\executable -Force; @'
import subprocess,pathlib
nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); py=['python','executable']
cases=['[[a b]; [1 2] [3 4]]','[1 20 \"abc\"]','[]','{}','[[name age]; [alice 30] [bob 9]]','[{a: 1} {a: 22, b: 3}]','{a: {b: 2}} | get a.b','[{a: 1} {a: 2}] | get a','[{a: 1,b:2}] | select a','[1 2 3] | first','[1 2 3] | last','[1 2 3] | first 2','[1 2 3 4] | skip 2','[1 2 2 3] | uniq','[1 2 3] | reverse','[1 2 3] | math sum','[1 2 3] | math avg','\"a,b,c\" | split row \",\"','[a b c] | str join \",\"','\"abcabc\" | str replace a x','\"abc\" | str starts-with a','\"hello world\" | str length','\"42\" | into int','[1 2] | enumerate','[{a:2} {a:1}] | sort-by a','[{a:1} {a:2}] | each {|r| "'$r.a + 10 }'"']

for c in cases:
 a=subprocess.run([nu,'--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True); b=subprocess.run(py+['--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True)

print('mismatches',count,'of',len(cases))
